recognize_zh: 低倍下普魯士藍鐵染色的骨髓顆粒，含脂肪空泡與紅色對比染色的細胞，但整個顆粒內完全找不到藍色含鐵血黃素顆粒（no stainable iron），支持骨髓鐵儲存耗竭。
features: Low power bone marrow aspirate particle with fat vacuoles and red-counterstained hematopoietic cells
Complete absence of blue hemosiderin granules within the particle stroma and macrophages
Adequate particle present, allowing interpretation of storage iron
Sideroblast assessment not possible at this magnification
describe_en: Low power view of a Prussian blue-stained bone marrow aspirate shows a cellular particle containing fat spaces and red-counterstained hematopoietic cells. No blue-staining hemosiderin is identified within the particle or its macrophages. Evaluation of sideroblasts requires higher magnification. Absent stainable marrow iron in an adequate particle is consistent with iron deficiency.

ddx.vs: Shows preserved or increased blue macrophage iron in particles with reduced sideroblasts.

ddx.dx: Technical false negative (aparticulate smear or decalcified core)
ddx.vs: Iron may be leached by acid decalcification or missed without particles, so the stain should be interpreted only on adequate aspirate particles with a positive control.
Marrow iron is typically increased with ring sideroblasts rather than absent.
